dedupe_notes: get_users_bookmarks returns posts in bookmark order (most recently bookmarked first), NOT post-date order. On sync, page with small max_results (10) and stop when an entire page is already seen, where seen = in captured_post_ids OR in state/exclusions.json. Excluded ids are skipped silently and never re-captured. bookmark_order_head lists the kept ids in the order X returned them; excluded bookmarks may sit between them in the live list. newest_post_id is the max post id captured (newest post by date), which is not necessarily the most recently bookmarked; use most_recently_bookmarked_post_id / bookmark_order_head to detect the head of the list.
known_quirks: max_results 25 or 100 returned a single page with no next_token (2026-10-26); max_results 10 paginated normally to the same ids
search_posts_all caps max_results at 25 per call; thread self-replies by the author count as replies (don't use -is:reply)
quoted X Articles arrive in includes.posts[].article with plain_text; code blocks are in article.entities.code, not in plain_text
